117 likes, 3 comments - cnet on October 30, 2026: "Ninja releases kitchen appliances so often that it’s hard to keep up. 🥣

If you have limited countertop space for appliances and want just one that can handle many cooking tasks, the MultiPot XL would be a great option. With 12 settings, it has more versatility than many competitors, but keep in mind that the “keep warm” function is included in the 12, and some functions won’t be used as much as others, such as sous vide. 

At $250, it’s more expensive than standard slow cookers and Instant Pots, but it could be a good option if you often cook large meals for a group. #ninjakitchen #ninjamultipot #multipotxl #kitchenappliance #slowcooker".

posts.meta_description:
98 likes, 7 comments - cnet on October 29, 2026: "Add to cart? DoorDash, the largest food delivery service in the US, is planning to acquire grocery delivery service Instacart in a massive $17 billion deal, DoorDash announced on Thursday.

According to DoorDash, once the deal is complete, both delivery services will continue to operate on separate platforms, and the Instacart name will remain. If you’re a DashPass and Instacart Plus subscriber, you will only have to pay one membership fee for perks from both platforms.

Should the deal move forward, it’s not expected to close before late 2027.

Read more at CNET.com #doordash #instacart #delivery #grocery #acquisition".
